taxonomy.title: AI-Powered Item Taxonomy Mapping
taxonomy.sub: MASTER DATA · AUTOMATED UNSPSC CLASSIFICATION TO LEVEL 4

steps.p: Item code, description and attributes are read from the master data.
The model interprets each item and infers its category automatically.
Item is mapped to the UNSPSC hierarchy from Level 1 down to Level 4.
Final UNSPSC code is assigned automatically — no human selection.

taxonomy.goal: Build an AI-powered tool that maps every item to its UNSPSC taxonomy down to Level 4 automatically — removing manual selection of the code for each item.
